name: Test: 100 W at 85 rpm
description: Equipment test. 15 minutes at a fixed 100 W in ERG with a cadence target of 85 rpm (80-90). Try drifting out of range on purpose to check the cadence card turns red and pulses, then settle back in.

messages.text: The cadence card should be green between 80 and 90.
Drop below 80 rpm on purpose. The card should turn red.
Back to 85. It should go green again.
Now try above 90 rpm. Red again?
Halfway. Check HR and power are steady.
